name: Panasonic KX-TGF320 DECT & Desk
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk. Photo to be confirmed.
description: The Panasonic KX-TGF320 is a home-office combo — a corded desk phone with a tiltable 3.4-inch display plus a cordless handset — with a 40-minute answering machine. Talking Caller ID announces who's calling, a Call Blocker stops nuisance numbers, and AAA backup keeps the base working in a power cut.
features: Talking Caller ID — announces the caller
